description: Inspect memory details or layer statistics. Without id: returns aggregate stats per layer (total, active, superseded, avg_confidence, top_entities). With id: returns the full memory row and optionally its history chain.

entity_name.description: Filter stats by entity name (used when id is omitted)

id.description: Memory ID to inspect. When provided, returns the full memory row and optionally its history chain.

include_history.description: When true and id is provided, include the full superseded chain (ancestor entries)

layer.description: Filter layer stats by this layer (used when id is omitted)

name: memory_inspect
